name: Fated Mate
storyline:
A troublesome dream leads you down a winding path, deep into the forest where the grass grows tall and wild and the trees conceal secrets. There, you discover something that will change your fate forever.

Thrust into a world of the past, facing a different time is not your only struggle, as there's something altogether different lurking in every being, an instinct pumping through their veins that fuels their base desires.
summary: Fated Mate is a spicy otome game about being transported into an ABO universe.
